name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 15 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2026-05-20, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 3.62 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
